description: Authoritative HD key-derivation golden vectors. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH that BOTH wallets must match: Android (ai.agentwallet.hd.HDWallet) and iOS (StellarService / Models). For each recovery phrase the three chain addresses are derived as: Stellar = SLIP-10 ed25519 at m/44'/148'/0' from the BIP39 seed with an EMPTY passphrase (SEP-0005); EVM = BIP-44 secp256k1 at m/44'/60'/0'/0/0 (EIP-55 checksummed); Solana = SLIP-10 ed25519 at m/44'/501'/0'/0' (base58). Every value was computed INDEPENDENTLY with the third-party bip_utils library (not from either app, not from the Rust core), so a mismatch on any platform is a real bug. Drift here means the two apps would compute DIFFERENT wallet addresses from the same secret phrase = funds sent to the wrong/uncontrolled address. Enforced by tests/protocol/hd-derivation-contract.test.mjs (pins both platform tests to these values), apps/ios/VelarumPayTests/HDDerivationGoldenTests.swift, apps/android/.../HDDerivationGoldenTest.java, and crates/velarum-wallet-core/tests/golden_vectors.rs.
